sentences.en: The students live in the residential college during their studies.
sentences.zh: 学生们在学习期间住在寄宿制学院里。

sentences.en: Many international students choose to stay at a residential college for cultural immersion.
sentences.zh: 许多国际学生选择住在寄宿制学院里进行文化交流。

sentences.en: The university is expanding its residential college to accommodate more freshmen next year.
sentences.zh: 大学正在扩建寄宿制学院，以便明年容纳更多的新生。
